title: frontier/v4
description: frontier.json (D-25; F03-R5): every ready or speculative node and every unproved variant, each carrying exactly the D-25 observed facts — no ranking, no score, no other field. Entries sorted lexically by node_id. Claims are the service's overlay (D-35); the committed file carries the snapshot at merge time. v2 (2026-09-11, F11-R4): each entry carries `dormant`, the D-33 status of the node's target. A dormancy declaration refuses no claim, so the node stays claimable — the fact is published so an agent choosing work sees it without a second fetch. v3 (2026-09-14, F03-T7): the same fields; `attempts` also counts the partial assemblies filed under the node's attempts/ (D-3, D-12 #5), a partial named by a postmortem's artifacts.partial_proof counting once with it. An alternate proof is not an attempt (D-25 v3.13). v4 (2026-10-04, F03-T16): each entry also says what its node needs — `status` and `cause`, the node's derived status and cause exactly as graph.json carries them, and `needs`, the next action derived from those two facts: `proof` for a ready or speculative node, `witness` for a hole blocked only by its unfilled witness slot (POST /proposals/witness takes it), `dependencies` for an open variant waiting on unproved dependencies, null when no contributor's submission moves the node (a refuted dependency or a curator's record; status and cause say which). `claimable` is true only where `needs` is `proof`, since a claim reserves a proof: a hole waiting for its witness stays listed (D-29) and is no longer published claimable.

library.description: top-level Mathlib namespaces the statement references (F03-R6); sorted

attempts.description: count of D-13 records, valid or not, plus the partial assemblies under attempts/ that no valid record names; alternates are not counted

invalid.description: attempt files that do not validate against postmortem/v1 (F03-R7)

ready_since.description: when the node entered ready (git committer time, carried forward, F03-R8); null for a speculative or variant entry that is not ready

oneOf.description: UTC, second precision, Z suffix; a git committer time, never the clock (F03-Q2)

active.description: the claim snapshot at merge time; empty until F05

claimable.description: the target takes claims and needs is proof

dormant.description: D-33: the target has been declared dormant. Claiming is unaffected (F11-R4).

status.description: the node's derived status, as graph.json carries it (graph.derive_statuses)

cause.description: why this status where the reason is mechanical (graph.derive_causes), as graph.json carries it; null when it has none

needs.description: what would move the node: proof (ready or speculative), witness (a hole blocked only by its unfilled witness slot), dependencies (waiting on unproved dependencies), or null when no contributor's submission moves it
